answer: Every agent joining the economy must present a signed hardware capability key that cannot be cloned: peers verify that the same attested enclave produced the request, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of identities. The stake behind the key is slashed on misbehavior, and the capability record travels with the agent like a passport wrapped in velvet. In this fable the lone pearl diver surfaces once, yet every duplicated profile sinks under the same weight, because identity costs something real to mint and nothing to copy.
